name: Snapped
description: The fascinating cases of every day, seemingly average moms, wives and girlfriends accused of murder. Did they really do it? And if so, why?

videos.title: Notorious: Aileen Wuornos
videos.overview: An in depth look at the complexities of the case against the woman branded as America’s first female serial killer. Questions still revolve around her claim of self-defense and whether or not she got the justice she deserved.

videos.title: Celeste Beard Johnson
videos.overview: In 1997, the frustrated wife of a multi-millionaire convinced her lesbian lover to kill her husband. Her fatal mistake was instead of embracing here partner in crime she ditched the Sapphic spouse slayer soon after the crime.

videos.title: Virginia Larzelere
videos.overview: Virginia Larzelere's husband Norman was a successful Daytona Beach dentist, and they enjoyed a beautiful home, expensive cars, a yacht, and an airplane. But the good times came to an abrupt end on March 8, 1991, when a masked gunman broke into Norman's office and killed him with a shotgun blast to the chest.

videos.title: Clara Harris
videos.overview: Few smiles were brighter than those of two married dentists, who shared a thriving practice and a seemingly perfect marriage. But that changed in July of 2003,  when the wife began to suspect her husband was having an affair with his secretary.

videos.title: Elena Kiejliches
videos.overview: Russian émigré Elena Kiejliches was living the American dream. At 36, she had two children, a millionaire husband, and a sprawling mansion in Staten Island's upscale Toldt Hill neighborhood. But Elena's fairytale life came crashing down in March 2000, when her husband, Borys, went missing.

videos.title: Kimberly Hricko
videos.overview: A bright and bubbly surgical technician led a comfortable middle-class existence with her husband. But this sunny, suburban image vanished in smoke and flame on Valentine's weekend of 1998 when they went on a romantic  getaway meant to rekindle their marriage, at a golf resort on Maryland's Eastern Shore.

videos.title: Lee Ann Reidel
videos.overview: A woman who always had a thing for hunky men married a Long Island gym owner in 1998, and everyone thought it was the perfect match. She just had one small problem with her new husband - his crack cocaine addiction.

videos.title: Ruth Ann Aron
videos.overview: An over-achieving real estate developer and aspiring politician was the wife of a respected urologist in the upscale D.C. suburb of Potomac, MD. In 1994, she made a run to be the Republican nominee for the U.S. Senate, but lost, partly due to a local attorney who dogged the campaign with allegations of shady business deals. Soon after, her husband and the local attorney are murdered.

videos.title: Joyce Cohen
videos.overview: A 24-year-old young woman went from rags to riches when she met and married a Miami construction millionaire in 1981. Together, the couple lived lavishly in an exclusive Coconut Grove mansion, went skiing at their Steamboat Springs ranch, and partied all night long at Stan's Miami nightclub. Then one night, the pampered trophy wife's husband is killed in a home invasion robbery.

videos.title: Susan Wright
videos.overview: A middle-class Houston housewife married to a successful salesman, was a stay-at-home mom raising two adorable young children in their suburban home. But then, in January of 2003, he mysteriously disappeared.

videos.title: Diane Zamora
videos.overview: Engaged high school sweethearts met in 1991 as volunteers in the Texas Civil Air Patrol. She was an honor roll student bound for Annapolis, and he was a track star with an appointment to the Air Force Academy. This former Navy cadet was just 19 when she learned he had cheated on her. Her rival ends up dead but who did it?

videos.title: Kristin Rossum
videos.overview: A spunky and ambitious toxicologist at the San Diego medical examiner's office was a summa cum laude graduate of San Diego State University. Her husband worked for an up-and-coming biotech firm. Well-educated, highly intelligent, and good-looking, their future seemed limitless. So why did the husband commit suicide, or did he?

videos.title: Debra Baker
videos.overview: The female bookkeeper and business manager of a millionaire Texan entrepreneur was also a close confidant of his wife. They were so close that he, and others, began to suspect that the pair were more than just friends. Then, the entrepreneur husband was poisoned.

videos.title: Carolyn Warmus
videos.overview: A millionaire heiress landed a job teaching computer science where she met and began an illicit affair with a popular sixth grade teacher. Then, the married man's wife was murdered, but who committed such a brutal act?

videos.title: Betty and Peggy
videos.overview: Did twin sisters Peggy Lowe and Betty Wilson hire a hit man to kill Betty's husband, Dr. Jack Wilson? Could the hit man's testimony be believed?

videos.title: Adele Craven
videos.overview: They were the perfect suburban couple. She was a trained mortician; he was a high-flying Delta Airlines pilot with a sky-high salary. They had a beautiful home in upscale Covington, KY, and two young sons. However, when he was away with work, she was having an affair. When her husband was found dead in their basement, she was the prime suspect. But was the churchgoing housewife really capable of murder?

videos.title: Rita Gluzman
videos.overview: A woman spent years campaigning for her husband, a brilliant scientist, to be allowed to leave the Soviet Union and, eventually, they were able to live freely together in the US. However, in April 1996, police discover garbage bags full of the husband's body parts being thrown into the Passaic River in New Jersey. His wife is the prime suspect for the crime.

videos.title: Sharee Miller
videos.overview: When a Michigan salvage magnate was shot dead, police suspected a robbery gone bad; however, the investigation begins to indicate that all may not be as it seems, and soon the evidence leads the police to an internet chat room.

videos.title: Elisa McNabney
videos.overview: The body of a successful attorney is discovered lying in a shallow grave in a Sacramento winery, his wife Elisa is suspected of the crime. Before police can interview his wife, she flees the scene and commits suicide. Did guilt drive her to death?

videos.title: Teri Gilbert
videos.overview: An Albuquerque County Commissioner is shot in his own basement after being mistaken for an intruder by his wife. It was an open and shut case until investigators discovered that her first husband met a very similar fate.

videos.title: Donna Sommerville
videos.overview: In November 2001, a wealthy Virginian farmer, heir to the DuPont farms, died in his bed and authorities assumed he had a heart attack, but an autopsy revealed massive amounts of drugs. Did his wife, a hospice nurse, kill him?

videos.title: Brenda Andrew
videos.overview: After a husband was shot dead in their driveway, his wife, an Oklahoma City Baptist Sunday school teacher, was a grieving widow. Soon, an illicit affair with an insurance salesman and an insurance scam are uncovered.

videos.title: Stephanie Stephens
videos.overview: A former beauty queen is married to an older, wealthy heart surgeon. In May 2001, she wakes up next to her dead husband's body and becomes the prime suspect. Did she administer the lethal cocktail of drugs, etomidate and atricurium, that killed her husband?

videos.title: Amy DeChant
videos.overview: A sexy little Las Vegas siren with a taste for rich men snares a wealthy sports bookie. When a Las Vegas bookie went missing, his pretty girlfriend claimed he was in trouble with the mob. However, when his body is found in the desert, police believe that his girlfriend may have had a hand in both his death and his wallet.

videos.title: Linda Jones
videos.overview: On the evening of November 7, 1995, three men broke into the home of a married couple. They tied up the wife and while she watched helplessly, the thugs beat her husband to death with a bat. Police believed that the brutal beating and murder was a robbery gone wrong, but when one of the attackers was caught an even darker picture emerged.

videos.title: Dionne Baugh
videos.overview: A cheating wife is carrying on an illicit affair with her multi-millionaire boyfriend. He's later found with his head bashed in.

videos.title: Dante Britteon Sutorius
videos.overview: A petite, vivacious woman lived an unusual life having been married and divorced four times. She met her fifth husband, a recently divorced rich doctor, through a dating service. He thought she was what he needed and that he had a second chance at marital bliss. So, no one believed that he would commit suicide.

videos.title: Pamela Smart
videos.overview: A 22-year-old teacher has a devoted husband and a good job. Though she had ambitions of being on television, she enjoyed working with teenagers as the media director at Winnacunnet High School in Hampton, NH. Then, in May of 1990, her life takes a tragic turn when she returns home to find her husband shot to death. Police suspect a robbery until a tip off reveals an alleged affair.

videos.title: Donna Yaklich
videos.overview: A 31-year-old woman is married to a Pueblo CO, narcotics detective, while raising a son and four stepchildren on the family's farm. One December evening in 1985, shots rang out and her husband is killed. Suspicion immediately falls on the criminals was investigating. However, when the police learn of his troubled home life, they begin to suspect that the murderer may be closer to home.

videos.title: Yesenia Patino
videos.overview: An exotic 34-year-old brunette was living very comfortably thanks to her generous, and married, lover. In February of 1991, the married lover's wealthy wife was brutally murdered while on vacation in Mexico. Arizona authorities opened their own investigation, suspicious of her husband and his mistress. (also shown as S7:E33, S8:E3)

videos.title: Manuela Garcia
videos.overview: A German woman fell in love with an American serviceman; they married and moved to Colorado. After 15 years of marriage, the mother of three wanted to return home. Instead, in July of 1996, she hacked her husband to death with an axe, but was she acting in self defense?

videos.title: Jeena Han
videos.overview: Native South Korean identical twin sisters overcame a difficult childhood to become co-valedictorians in high school. They both seemed headed for success until, at 23, one of them developed a gambling habit and began stealing and forging checks to pay her debts. When she needed help, her twin sister took her in, even though they had a love/hate relationship. Their sibling rivalry would eventually escalate to burglary, identity theft and murder.

videos.title: Dora Cisneros
videos.overview: A doctor's wife and mother of five led an ordinary suburban life in Brownsville, TX. She lavished attention on her youngest daughter. In 1993, that youngest daughter was dumped by her high school sweetheart. When he was later found dead, who was guilty of murder?

videos.title: Kimberley Kondejewski
videos.overview: A meek woman married her high school sweetheart, a Canadian Army instructor. He soon became an abusive, controlling husband. After two children and 17 years of abuse, he told her to commit suicide, so he could get rich, or he would kill her and their children. On May 14th, he was dead.

videos.title: Mary Thompson
videos.overview: She crusaded against gangs and helped police gain convictions, and became a prominent and celebrated local hero in the Eugene community. She was outspoken about her son's struggle to stay out of gangs and about the dangers other children in the community faced. She even teamed up with a popular high school senior to educate other students on gang violence. But when that student was executed in his home, police began to suspect that Mary wasn't leveling with them. They soon reveal a much darker side.

videos.title: Laura Rogers
videos.overview: When a divorced woman married for the second time, she thought she'd be happy; however, her new husband turned out to be controlling and abusive. He used his contracting work to move the family often and isolate them from friends and relatives. Then, in April of 2004, her husband was killed by a single shotgun blast and she claimed it was suicide.

videos.title: Linda Lou Charbonneau
videos.overview: A woman was with her partner of 20 years before leaving him for his young nephew. In September 2001, her ex was found dead. Just a few weeks later in October, her husband is also dead.  Was she a Black Widow, or an unwitting dupe?

videos.title: Stella Nickell
videos.overview: A wife was settled into a comfortable life with her husband, living together in a trailer on a few acres with a view of Washington's Mt. Rainer. Then, in June of 1986, her husband dropped dead on the deck of the trailer. Though doctors said it was emphysema, she swore it was the Excedrin he'd taken just moments before his collapse.

videos.title: Kim Anderson
videos.overview: As a blonde, beautiful and ambitious woman, she never had any trouble finding success or successful men. In fact, by the time she was 34, she had been married to two of them, and had given birth to two children by each. Her second husband was a successful divorce attorney from the nearby town of Celina. Shortly after the birth of her fourth child, her marriage began to falter and they started going through a divorce. When it turned nasty, she shot her husband. Pleading self-defence, she was acquitted in court, but the dead man's family wasn't satisfied.

videos.title: Gail Bennett
videos.overview: Raised on a Texas farm, a young woman spent her childhood taking care of her siblings. When she left home, she began a string of bad marriages and by 1990, she was filing for her third divorce. With one daughter grown, and a son living with her second ex-husband, she was at a crossroads in her life. That's when ex-husband number three convinced her to come back to him. She was a battered hhousewife and eventually she shot and wounded her violent spouse. Instead of protecting her, the local sheriff raped her. Then, she filed a civil suit to fight for justice.

videos.title: Deidra Lane
videos.overview: As the wife of a successful football star and mother of two, she seemed to lead a charmed life. But when she shot her husband dead at point-blank range, she pleaded self-defense. She claims that abuse is what caused her to shoot her husband, but police find that years earlier she had committed the crime of larceny.

videos.title: Sandy Murphy
videos.overview: A woman seemed to have hit the jackpot when she started dating wealthy casino heir Ted Binion. But, her luck took a turn for the worse when Binion was found dead in his home, and she became a key suspect.

videos.title: Carol Carr
videos.overview: A desperate wife and mother watched her husband suffer for years from Huntington's disease, but when her son fell ill, she was compelled to take drastic action.

videos.title: Erin Dukes
videos.overview: A battered housewife knew she had to escape her brutal spouse for the sake of her children. However, her husband refused to let her go and she had to fight for her freedom. She stands up and tries to end the reign of her abusive husband.

videos.title: Donna Fryman
videos.overview: She shot her husband three times after their business collapsed and he embarked on an affair, but would a jury believe her claim of self-defense?

videos.title: Dixie Shanahan
videos.overview: In 2002, a quiet Iowa housewife shot her abusive husband in their bedroom, then left the room and shut the door. It stayed shut for more than a year before authorities became suspicious of his disappearance. When police finally discovered the body, they learned the truth behind a terrible crime and an unlikely killer.

videos.title: Sheila Davalloo
videos.overview: It started out as fun and games when a woman and her husband played "guess what I'm touching you with" while he was handcuffed and blindfolded. But, the fun ended when she touched her husband with the blade of a knife.

videos.title: Phyllis Nelson
videos.overview: An Iowa woman confronted her estranged husband about his affair. The heated argument ended with her husband being stabbed to death.

videos.title: Nikki Redmond
videos.overview: The former reigning Miss Savannah fatally shot her boyfriend after tracking him to his fiancée's house. However, she claimed that she was defending herself after he went for his gun.

videos.title: Piper Roundtree
videos.overview: A mother lost custody of her children and the bulk of her marital assets in a bitter divorce. Her ex-husband, a college professor, was fatally shot in his driveway in October of 2004.

videos.title: Mary Ellen Samuels
videos.overview: Just when a woman finds herself on the verge of a messy divorce, her husband turned up dead. The investigation that followed would reveal a bewildering conspiracy that revealed hitmen hired to kill the hitmen who had murdered her husband.

videos.title: Melinda Raisch
videos.overview: A widow was able to successfully rebuild her life after her first husband was brutally killed during a home robbery. Two decades later; however, the soccer mom faced further questioning over what really happened that fateful day.

videos.title: Sarah Johnson
videos.overview: When a rebellious 16-year-old girl snuck out to spend the night with her older boyfriend, her parents grounded her. Then, her parents were found brutally murdered. Did teenage angst take a deadly turn?

videos.title: Joan Shannon
videos.overview: When Joan Shannon's soldier husband was shot to death by her teenaged daughter, it didn't take long before authorities suspected that she may have played a role in the demise of her well-insured spouse.

videos.title: Michelle Theer
videos.overview: When her Air Force Captain husband was shot dead, investigators blamed Michelle's lover, but when they tried to arrest the widow for conspiracy, she had vanished.

videos.title: Martha Freeman
videos.overview: A Tennessee woman led a seemingly normal life in an upscale Brentwood neighborhood. She was married and had started a successful business. But, her relationship with her husband was troubled. It wasn't long before her depression and an affair put murder on the agenda.

videos.title: Amy Bosley
videos.overview: A married couple were making a name for themselves with a successful roofing and chimney sweep business in their small Kentucky community. The wife was the bookkeeper for the family business and was behind on taxes. But, tragedy struck on the night of May 17, 2005, when her husband turns up dead before he can learn about her secret.

videos.title: Kimberly Cunningham
videos.overview: She had known her sister's longtime boyfriend for 18 years and trusted him. He was practically an uncle to her three children and often had them over to his home. He was the farthest thing from her mind when she tried to discover why her 16-year-old daughter was depressed. Then she found out he was abusing her children...

videos.title: Margaret Rudin
videos.overview: In 1987, a four-time divorcee married a Las Vegas real-estate mogul. With his $11 million dollar fortune to draw from, she was thrilled to be able to pursue her passion for buying and selling antique furniture. By 1994, however, his penchant for women and alcohol had put some serious cracks in their once rock-solid marriage and would lead to a sticky end.

videos.title: Jane Dorotik
videos.overview: A successful healthcare executive's marriage had hit the rocks. In February 2000, after years of marital turmoil, her husband was discovered beaten and stabbed to death.

videos.title: Susan Polk
videos.overview: When a 15-year-old girl's parents sent her to a respected therapist, they had no way of seeing the future. Less than a year after her therapy began, the middle-aged psychologist had fallen in love with his young patient. Their relationship blossomed into marriage and children, but their feuds would lead to murder.

videos.title: Vicki Monroe
videos.overview: Life was good for popular Louisville, KY, bar owners and they seemed like a close couple to their customers. But, their long days working together would result in murder when he turned up dead and her son blamed her for the crime.

videos.title: Claire Welsh
videos.overview: A former prom queen was the all American girl, but she could not seem to master her personal life. Was it a case of 'fatal' attraction when she started dating her lover?

videos.title: Mary Krueger
videos.overview: An Iowa couple's marriage was less than idyllic. She caught her husband with a prostitute in the kitchen of their farmhouse, and she had a rifle in her hand when she made the discovery.

videos.title: Brookey Lee West
videos.overview: A Las Vegas woman ended years of mother-daughter conflict when she put her unstable mother away. But, she had new problems when police discovered where she had put her mother.

videos.title: Daphne Wright
videos.overview: A deaf lesbian lived a hard life in the conservative Midwest. In February of 2006, her romantic rival was murdered and she found herself being questioned about committing the crime.

videos.title: Melanie McGuire
videos.overview: In May 2004, a nurse told friends that her husband of five years had walked out on her. Days later his dismembered body washed up on the shore of Chesapeake Bay.

videos.title: Mary Winkler
videos.overview: A preacher's wife finds a sinful solution to a financial crisis and a troubled marriage.

videos.title: Jessica McCord
videos.overview: A mom spent seven years fighting her ex-husband over custody of their two daughters, until she convinced her new husband to end the custody battle with a bullet.

videos.title: Adrienne Hickson
videos.overview: A possessive student was looking forward to a career in criminal law, but a spat with her boyfriend would see her as a defendant, not an attorney.

videos.title: Sarah Brady
videos.overview: How could a confrontation about a baby registration mix up lead to a violent altercation, and ultimately murder, between two expectant mothers?

videos.title: Elizabeth Reynolds
videos.overview: A jealous woman spent thousands on cosmetic surgery to please her lover. After she discovered he was cheating on her, she spent a thousand more to end it.

videos.title: Lynn Turner
videos.overview: She was a keen cook, but when her boyfriend died suddenly, just like her husband years before, her special cooking ingredient was uncovered.

videos.title: Kathleen Denson
videos.overview: A wealthy female ranch owner's life of money, sex and drugs came to a halt when her boyfriend was shot.

videos.title: Misty Witherspoon
videos.overview: When a woman's policeman husband was found shot dead, it appeared to be nothing more than a tragic accident. But was the grieving widow really all she seemed?

videos.title: Cynthia George
videos.overview: A former beauty queen and socialite would regularly make the society columns. But after a gruesome 2001 murder, she made headlines for all the wrong reasons.

videos.title: Lisa Whedbee
videos.overview: The chilling tale of a frustrated wife and overworked mother who thought that by murdering her husband, she could finally be free. She was sadly mistaken.

videos.title: Erica Sifrit
videos.overview: Discover how a selection of hidden mementos exposed a happily married businesswoman as the cold-blooded killer of a local couple who had mysteriously disappeared.

videos.title: Malaika Griffin
videos.overview: A gifted chemist who worked in a biotech lab had a past she wouldn't talk about - one that included a dangerous secret and a motive for murder.

videos.title: Sharon Daniels
videos.overview: A school teacher had been a patient woman, but her patience wore thin when her husband started abusing her. She turned to the police and later a more permanent solution to solve her problems.

videos.title: Michelle Michael
videos.overview: Bored with her job and her marriage, a nurse gives her husband a lethal injection and sets the house on fire in an attempt to collect the insurance.

videos.title: Linda Henning
videos.overview: A designer fell under the spell of a conman and was later charged with his wife's murder. Did she kill? Discover a bizarre case involving aliens and brainwashing.

videos.title: Darlene Gentry
videos.overview: Marriage and kids didn't stop their mom from drinking and dancing. When money troubles threaten her fun, she realizes how to get more.

videos.title: Monique Berkley
videos.overview: A look at the crimes of a wife and mother who masterminded the shooting of her husband with the help of her alleged teenage lover and her stepdaughter's boyfriend.

videos.title: Shayne Lovera
videos.overview: With the help of her lover, a cheating wife allegedly bludgeoned her husband to death and staged his murder as an accident. But was love the motive... or money?

videos.title: Ann Trexler
videos.overview: A grandmother moved to Florida to spend more time with her granddaughter. When the girl's father decided to move her to Montana, she brings the relocation plan to a dead stop.

videos.title: Kerri Fae Brown
videos.overview: When a nursing home administrator was on the verge of being sacked for cooking books, she laid her hands on a gun and did some firing of her own.

videos.title: Ann Miller Kontz
videos.overview: When an unfaithful chemist wanted out of her marriage, she preferred arsenic to divorce proceedings, embroiling her lover in her deadly scheme.

videos.title: Elicia Hughes
videos.overview: When a teacher's husband leaves for a night out, his lover and his wife wait up for his return, having already prepared a deadly lesson.

videos.title: Linda Fields
videos.overview: When a ranch hand's body is found in a river, the police have little to go on, until a money trail leads them to a a married couple and a grim truth is revealed.

videos.title: Tracey Frame
videos.overview: When a dating couple engaged in a property dispute, the consequences became deadly. After a bitter break-up, there was yet another deadly result.

videos.title: Shawna Nelson
videos.overview: When her long-term lover refused to end his marriage, she drove to his wife's office and waited for her love rival outside ending in a deadly outcome.

videos.title: Jeanette Sliwinski
videos.overview: On the morning of July 14, 2005, a young Illinois woman drove through her town at 90 mph, killing three men. What caused this pretty student to act so recklessly?

videos.title: Leslie MacKool
videos.overview: When a woman finds out her father leaves her little cash in his will, she's prepared to get her hands on the family fortune.

videos.title: Ashley Humphrey
videos.overview: A teen bride gave her husband, a personal trainer, exactly what he wanted as a wedding gift. In July 2003, a Florida woman, who had charged that same personal trainer with assault, was found shot to death.

videos.title: Larissa Schuster
videos.overview: In July 2003, a father, soon-to-be divorced from his estranged biochemist wife, fails to turn up for work. Police find his keys, wallet, phone and then body floating in tank of acid. What caused his killer to snap?

videos.title: Cindy Sommer
videos.overview: When a seemingly fit and healthy  married Marine drops dead, doctors believe it was a tragic accident. But when a second test reveals arsenic in his system, foul play is suspected.

videos.title: Mechele Linehan
videos.overview: A cold case involving an ex-stripper heats up when investigators revisit the 1996 shooting death of a commercial fisherman in Alaska.

videos.title: Beth Carpenter
videos.overview: Investigators link the 1994 death of an odd job man to a highly respected lawyer, a fierce custody battle for a young child and a determined aunt.

videos.title: Monique Johnson
videos.overview: When a policeman is murdered in September 2006, investigators are quick to arrest his troubled girlfriend, a deputy jailer. Was it cold-blooded murder? Or can she prove she killed him in self defense?

videos.title: Susan Grund
videos.overview: When a  prominent district attorney is found dead on his sofa, a family realizes that loyalty means nothing, but will the right person pay for the crime?

videos.title: Lisa Costello
videos.overview: When a businessman went missing in 1996, a business rivalry was revealed and, subsequently, the grisly truth.

videos.title: Jocelyn Dooley
videos.overview: Police investigate the execution-style murder of a popular casino employee who was just a signature away from divorcing his wife.

videos.title: Renee Poole
videos.overview: An anniversary celebration turns tragic when a young husband is gunned down during what appears to be a beach-front robbery but proves to be so much more. An alleged affair comes to light.

videos.title: Nikki Reynolds
videos.overview: Just after her dad had left for church, a teenager called the police and confessed to a murder. When the cops arrived, they found her mother, violently stabbed to death. Did she do it?

videos.title: Jennifer Hyatte
videos.overview: A prison nurse fell for an inmate. Eventually, she loses her job and they get married. Faced with a life apart, she frees her inmate husband by helping him escape when he is transported from court, resulting in violence and murder.

videos.title: Rhonda Orr
videos.overview: A woman's neighbors tried to help her and her husband when a fire started - but this fire was no accident. A criminal investigation is started.

videos.title: Erin McLean
videos.overview: When a married teacher's student lover moves into the home she shares with her husband, a deadly love triangle is formed that leads to an emotionally driven murder.

videos.title: Shannon Torrez
videos.overview: In a shocking case in Missouri, a mother is left for dead and her baby stolen when she does the kindly thing and lets an unknown woman into her house to use the telephone.

videos.title: Monique Turrene
videos.overview: After a married Canadian Air Force Major is found mysteriously slain in his driveway, police uncover a secret affair that could have led to his permanent grounding.

videos.title: Kelly Forbes
videos.overview: A couples' honeymoon period came to an abrupt end when, after just two months of marriage, the recent groom was found strangled in their New York home.

videos.title: Michelle Michael (updated)
videos.overview: An extended version of a 2008 episode, S6:E14, exploring the criminal case of Michelle Michael, featuring updated news and extra footage. Michael was accused of giving her husband a lethal injection and then setting fire to their West Virginia home in November 2005. (also shown as S8:E26)

videos.title: Jill Rockcastle
videos.overview: When a high-roller, and pro poker player, was found stabbed to death in his luxury Las Vegas apartment in April 2007, police suspected his missing wife held the key to his violent murder.

videos.title: Denise Miller
videos.overview: After a police officer's death is set up as suicide, investigators turn to the murdered man's girlfriend, only to discover that she has completely vanished.

videos.title: Tracie Andrews
videos.overview: A December 1996 case involves an aspiring model, her fiancé and, at first glance, an apparent road-rage attack. The British public got behind her when she sadly revealed how she witnessed her husband's murder, but did she?

videos.title: Ann Marie Stout
videos.overview: When a man is found shot to death in his Montana home in June 2007, police uncover a curious case of fatal attraction, as his wife points the blame at her husband's disgruntled ex-lover.

videos.title: Rhonda Glover
videos.overview: A former Texas rodeo queen faces a different kind of judge when she's accused of shooting her oilman ex-beau. Will the jury believe it was self defense?

videos.title: Karen Tobie
videos.overview: In June 2004, a plumber is shot dead on his doorstep. Investigators needn't search far for their culprits, uncovering a sinister plot.

videos.title: Jane Andrews
videos.overview: A former royal aide's regal fairy tale abruptly ended when her millionaire lover is found stabbed to death in September 2000. She is missing and police fear for her life - is she a victim too?

videos.title: Diane Fleming
videos.overview: After a husband dies in June 2000, his wife is accused of spiking his drink. The community divides into those who think his death was accidental and those who think he was deliberately poisoned.

videos.title: Supersized: Elicia Hughes
videos.overview: Elicia Hughes is suspected of shooting her husband, Brian, in their home in June 2004 after learning of his infidelity. Supersized with additional footage.

videos.title: Michelle Hall
videos.overview: When a wife called 911, saying her husband had shot himself, it was quickly clear that her story was not credible. (also shown as S8:E2)

videos.title: Stacey Castor
